methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This article is devoted to the analysis of how ISO 50001 can solve existing problems in the field of energy and how it contributes to save energy resources.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper addresses the importance and organisational/policy-level implementation of ISO 50001 energy management systems (EnMS) in Uzbek manufacturing enterprises. It does not present, characterise, or evaluate any EnPI/EnB measurement model: no measured/normalised quantity, normalisation variables, functional form, or baseline construction/estimation approach is identified. EnPI/EnB content is only incidental (generic 'key indicators').

paper_type.evidence_quote: The purpose of such a systematic review is to identify relevant existing studies

stage1.notes: Self-framed systematic review of EnMS/ISO 50001 implementation importance in Uzbek enterprises; managerial/policy scope with no EnPI/EnB measurement-model content. Ineligible under v2.3 review/synthesis decision-tree step 1 (models not characterised); not genuinely borderline.
